summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature (module-level functions, Progress.open/wrap_file methods, private reader and context wrapper) in rich/progress.py, added 19 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added two docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (no deleted lines). Tests, black and mypy were not run, per instructions. Known risk: _ProgressReader.readinto calls handle.readinto, which typing.BinaryIO does not declare, so mypy will likely flag it; no ignore comment was added. Other choices: mode 'tr' is validated and normalizes to 'rt' but returns a binary reader, following the spec's wording; Progress.open has an extra str-mode overload; the reader defines mode and name properties because BinaryIO's abstract members would otherwise block instantiation; Progress.open calls io.open because the module-level open shadows the builtin. Nothing was committed.
